name: Go Agent Sandbox
postStartCommand:
if [ -f /home/dev/.gitignore_global ]; then git config --global core.excludesFile /home/dev/.gitignore_global; fi; if [ -n "${GIT_USER_NAME:-}" ]; then git config --global user.name "$GIT_USER_NAME"; fi; if [ -n "${GIT_USER_EMAIL:-}" ]; then git config --global user.email "$GIT_USER_EMAIL"; fi; app_auth_configured=false; if [ -n "${GITHUB_APP_ID:-}" ] && [ -n "${GITHUB_APP_INSTALL_ID:-}" ] && { [ -n "${GITHUB_APP_KEY_BASE64:-}" ] || [ -n "${GITHUB_APP_KEY_PATH:-}" ]; }; then /usr/local/bin/init-github-app.sh || echo "Warning: GitHub App auth failed (continuing anyway)"; app_auth_configured=true; fi; if [ "$app_auth_configured" != "true" ]; then key_path=""; if [ -n "${SSH_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$SSH_DIR" ]; then key_path="$SSH_DIR"; elif [ -n "${SSH_DIR:-}" ] && [ -d "$SSH_DIR" ] && [ -f "$SSH_DIR/id_ed25519" ]; then key_path="$SSH_DIR/id_ed25519"; elif [ -f "/home/dev/.ssh/blacktop-bot" ]; then key_path="/home/dev/.ssh/blacktop-bot"; elif [ -f "/home/dev/.ssh/id_ed25519" ]; then key_path="/home/dev/.ssh/id_ed25519"; fi; if [ -n "$key_path" ]; then mkdir -p /home/dev/.ssh; printf "Host github.com
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile %s
  IdentitiesOnly yes
" "$key_path" > /home/dev/.ssh/config; chmod 600 /home/dev/.ssh/config; fi; fi; if [ "$FIREWALL_ENABLED" = "true" ]; then sudo /usr/local/bin/init-firewall.sh; fi; /usr/local/bin/init-gemini-extensions.sh || true; /usr/local/bin/init-mcp.sh || true
